do i have to type the word "XXXXX" in an empty space right after it, and then change my cursor, or is there a way i can simply use the word "XXXXX" without mentioning its name? 
i hope i'm not putting too much information here, i'm just trying to figure out if there is a way? 

a:

yes, you can simply type "XXXXX" without mentioning the word "XXXXX". 
i would think the problem you are facing with this isn't that you need to avoid using the word "XXXXX", but that you should not be using the word like it is a part of you. you might be trying to say "XXXXX's parents", but "XXXXX's parents" would not be acceptable in most situations.
think of it like the way people usually put things in italic: "the text should really be in italics". if you use the word "XXXXX", it will
